citations.summary: Astronaut Strength, Conditioning, and Rehabilitation Specialists (ACERS) follow crew fitness during flight and tailor exercise prescriptions to each crew member's ability and performance. Ground teams review crew data, including physiological markers and the duration and intensity of exercise sessions, and strength prescriptions depend on the equipment on board.

Work is under way on a spacecraft medical data architecture to support clinical decision support tools, which might apply artificial intelligence and machine learning to assist in diagnosing and treating illness. Virtual assistants are also being studied as a way to help crews on distant missions recognize and respond quickly to spaceflight anomalies.
